page_title: AUG 2-1 MON | Augsburg v B. Monchengladbach 04/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' The foul by Maximilian Bauer (Augsburg) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Florian Badstubner.
90+5' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90+3' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
90+2' Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach) is penalised for holding. Florian Badstubner signals a set piece.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
87' The game is interrupted. Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
86' Augsburg can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
85' Substitution. Elvis Rexhbecaj walks off the pitch and Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) comes on as a substitute.
84' Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Florian Badstubner ignores the protests.
83' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
81' Gerardo Seoane prepares a substitution. Alassane Plea is replaced by Grant-Leon Ranos (B. Monchengladbach).
80' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
78' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 6:4.
76' It is time for a substitution. Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) is on for Joe Scally.
75' The ball goes out for a corner. Augsburg can continue in their attacking effort.
73' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) picks up a yellow card for a foul.

72' 2 - 1 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go inside the left post. The score changes to 2:1.
72' B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
70' B. Monchengladbach are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
68' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Chrislain Matsima (Augsburg) replacing Keven Schlotterbeck.
68' Wonderful movement by Augsburg. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
68' B. Monchengladbach will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
65' 2 - 0 Goal! Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) fires the rebound low into the middle of the goal after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:0.
64' Today's match ends for Tomas Cvancara who will be replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
64' Gerardo Seoane has decided to make a change. Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) replaces Philipp Sander.
62' Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) is well placed to meet a cross and sends a difficult header towards the left post, but the goalkeeper reacts well to stop the effort.
62' B. Monchengladbach failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
61' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, B. Monchengladbach are going to take it.
59' A yellow card for a tackle by Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach). Florian Badstubner doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
59' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
57' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) will replace Steve Mounie.
57' Here is a change. Marius Wolf is going off and Jess Thorup gives the last tactical orders to Henri Koudossou (Augsburg).
56' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
54' The resulting set piece from Augsburg is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
54' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. Augsburg will take a corner kick.

51' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
50' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

49' B. Monchengladbach slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.

49' Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) runs onto the ball inside the box and smashes it towards the bottom right corner. It's a great effort but an even better save from Nediljko Labrovic, who tips the ball around the post.
46' Here comes a substitution. Marvin Friedrich (B. Monchengladbach) is brought on as a substitute for Nico Elvedi.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The end of the first half.
45' The linesman makes the right call and Augsburg will have a corner.
44' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the bottom left corner and forces a good save out of Moritz Nicolas.
42' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
38' 1 - 0 Goal! Keven Schlotterbeck (Augsburg) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the top of the net. He makes it 1:0.
38' The ball goes out of play. Augsburg are awarded a corner kick.

38' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the left post. His promising effort is kept out by Moritz Nicolas, who pulls off a stunning save! Corner kick. Augsburg will have an opportunity.
37' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
36' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle and it's Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
36' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but Moritz Nicolas comes off his line to gather the ball.
35' Ko Itakura (B. Monchengladbach) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
34' Florian Badstubner blows his whistle. Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) commits a foul after dangerous play.

31' CHANCE! Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) fires just wide of the right post from inside the box after running onto a splendid pass from Alassane Plea. The ball goes out of play and Augsburg will have a goal kick.
29' Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.

28' B. Monchengladbach slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
25' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Marius Wolf (Augsburg), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
23' B. Monchengladbach take a short corner kick.

23' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The ball goes out of play. B. Monchengladbach are awarded a corner kick.
23' Wonderful movement by B. Monchengladbach. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
20' Augsburg are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
19' Frank Onyeka (Augsburg) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
16' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Moritz Nicolas, who smothers the ball.
14' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.
13' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Florian Badstubner blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) controls a square pass, he moves forward then unleashes a wild shot from mid-range which goes so far wide it nearly hits the corner flag.
11' B. Monchengladbach work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
11' B. Monchengladbach restart play with a quick free kick.
10' B. Monchengladbach seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
8' B. Monchengladbach show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.

5' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. B. Monchengladbach are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
4' Steve Mounie (Augsburg) is caught offside!
2' It looks like Steve Mounie (Augsburg) saw red with that tackle. Florian Badstubner won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Augsburg will take the kick-off.
Florian Badstubner is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
